2607.18114.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
2607.18114.paper_summary: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal intervention. The susceptibility is largely installed by alignment tuning rather than pretraining: pretrained base models barely cave to these biases, and their activations carry no cue-specific signal beyond question content. Within aligned models, each bias becomes a single coherent direction that we can both decode and steer along, recovering the unbiased answer across every family we test. The biases stay representationally distinct, however: cross-bias entanglement is model-specific rather than a property of the bias category, and even behaviorally similar biases occupy different directions. The same intervention also serves as a modest debiasing tool, recovering a meaningful share of bias-induced errors while preserving most correct answers across all instruct families. Cue-induced bias is therefore best understood not as a single flaw in LLMs but as a family of distinct, causally active directions that alignment tuning installs.
2607.18114.paper_summary_zh: 現代的LLM對於意外簡單的無形輸入提示變化驚人地敏感：隨意的提示、一個標記錯誤的少量示例，或一個虛假的先前助手回合往往會顛覆原本正確的答案。我們研究這種敏感性，涵蓋了諂媚及相關的提示誘導偏見，存在於模型的哪個部分。在五個模型系列和七種BCT偏見類型中，我們從隱藏狀態中提取每種偏見的方向，並通過三個指標進行三角測量：探測、留一數據集轉移和因果干預。這種敏感性主要是由對齊調整而非預訓練所引起：預訓練的基礎模型幾乎不會屈服於這些偏見，其激活不攜帶超出問題內容的提示特定信號。在對齊模型中，每種偏見變成一個單一的連貫方向，我們可以解碼並沿著這個方向引導，恢復我們測試的每個系列中的無偏答案。然而，這些偏見在表徵上仍然是不同的：跨偏見的糾纏是模型特定的，而不是偏見類別的屬性，即使行為上相似的偏見也佔據不同的方向。同樣的干預也作為一種適度的去偏見工具，恢復了由偏見引起的錯誤的有意義部分，同時保留了所有指令系列中的大多數正確答案。因此，提示誘導偏見最好被理解為LLM中的一個家族，而不是單一的缺陷，這個家族由對齊調整所安裝的不同、因果活躍的方向組成。
